jobs.title: Infant development program specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

As an Infant Development Program Specialist, you’ll support infants and young children with developmental delays and disabilities through individualized, play-based learning. You’ll plan and deliver early intervention activities, partner with families, and coordinate with educators and other professionals to help each child build communication, social, cognitive, and motor skills. Your impact: By adapting instruction to each child’s needs and working closely with families, you help children participate more fully in everyday learning and routines.

**Responsibilities**

* Observe children’s development and use findings to guide lesson planning, curriculum development, and individualized education program (IEP) goals.
* Provide early intervention, preschool special education, and developmentally appropriate childcare, including toddler care when needed.
* Use classroom management and positive behavior management strategies; apply applied behavior analysis (ABA) principles when appropriate.
* Collaborate with families, speech therapy providers, and other professionals to coordinate student support.
* Maintain accurate records and follow applicable educational compliance requirements; use learning technology and standardized assessments as appropriate.

**Skills**

* Experience in early childhood education, classroom teaching, preschool, daycare, childcare, or private school settings; experience working with children and students with disabilities or developmental delays is valuable.
* Knowledge of special education, deaf education, literacy education, math, childhood development, child welfare, and special education law is an asset.
* Familiarity with behavioral therapy, behavior support for students with special needs, physical education, and teaching students with developmental disabilities is preferred.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with families and multidisciplinary teams.
* Understanding of educational regulations and experience supporting children with autism or other developmental disabilities is preferred.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sherman Oaks, CA 91423

jobs.title: HR Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job no:** 563482  
**Work type:** Staff  
**Location:** Long Beach  
**Categories:** Confidential, Administrative, Temporary, Full Time

Join the vibrant community at California State University, Long Beach (CSULB)!

Located just three miles from the Pacific Ocean, CSULB offers an inspiring workplace and an exceptional Southern California lifestyle. Our 322-acre campus—one of the largest in the CSU system—serves more than 42,000 students and is known for its commitment to student success, innovation, and impactful academic and research initiatives.

As a member of the CSULB community, you’ll experience a dynamic environment filled with cultural landmarks, collaborative energy, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference.

Work-life balance thrives here. Long Beach blends coastal relaxation with urban vibrancy, offering miles of beaches, year-round sunshine, a thriving arts and food scene, and convenient access to both Los Angeles and Orange County. It’s an ideal place to grow your career while enjoying everything Southern California has to offer.

Join the California State University (CSU) and explore career opportunities that advance student success and strengthen California’s future—offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and professional growth.

### **Job Summary**

Under general direction, the incumbent administers and coordinates the Driver Authorization and Safe Driver Program, ensuring driver applications, training, compliance requirements, and related documentation are accurately maintained and processed. The position also provides support for HR programs and operations, including background screening, training and recognition, exit surveys, Fee Waiver, Staff Emeritus, and other departmental and administrative activities.

This position also provides strategic program support involving a variety of employee and labor relations function within Staff Human Resources. This role grants the incumbent access to management's strategies and positions on collective bargaining negotiations at CSU Long Beach.

* DRIVER AUTHORIZATION & SAFE DRIVER PROGRAM. Coordinates the campus Driver Authorization and Safe Driver Program, including driver applications, required training, DMV/EPN monitoring, compliance tracking, audits, and communication with campus departments.
* DEPARTMENT & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT. Provides administrative and operational support for HRM, including website and guideline updates, purchasing and budget support, facilities coordination, and special projects.

* RECOGNITION PROGRAMS. Supports employee training and recognition programs through event coordination, course administration, SharePoint updates, and tracking of participation and feedback.
* EXIT SURVEY FOLLOW-UP. Coordinates follow-up with separated employees to support completion of Exit Surveys and prepares related tracking reports for management.

Staff Human Resources

1.0 time-base, 40 hours per week.

### **Duration of Appointment**

This is a temporary position for 1 year with no permanent status granted. Temporary assignments may expire prior to the ending date.

### **Classification**

Confidential Administrative Support I

Salary placement is determined by the education, experience, and qualifications the candidate brings to the position, internal equity, and the hiring department’s fiscal resources.

* Hiring Range: The hiring range for this position is $4,261 - $5,000 per month commensurate with candidate's education, experience, skills, and training.
* CSU Classification Salary Range: The CSU Classification Salary Range for this position is $4,261 - $8,166 per month.

To be eligible for full benefits, employees must be appointed at least half-time (.50 FTE) with an appointment lasting more than six months and one day. * **Health Coverage:** A variety of medical, dental, and vision plans.

* **Educational Benefits:** Tuition fee waiver programs for eligible employees; dependent eligibility varies by employee group and bargaining unit.

* **Additional Benefits:** Wellness programs, professional development opportunities, and insurance options including life, disability, and pet insurance.

Candidates are encouraged to review the appropriate CSU Employee Benefits Summary for details specific to their position. Additionally, the CSU Total Compensation Calculator is available to help prospective employees understand the full value of the CSU benefits package and how it complements base salary.

jobs.title: Tiktok Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

As a TikTok Account Manager, you’ll shape engaging social media programs that help brands connect with audiences and strengthen their digital presence. You’ll manage TikTok accounts from planning through performance review, combining creative content, audience insights, and clear communication. Your work may also support campaigns across other social media platforms.

**Duties**

* Develop social media marketing plans, content calendars, and social media content marketing tailored to brand goals and audiences.
* Lead content creation, including content writing, social media content creation, photography, graphic design, and video editing; use Adobe Creative Suite tools such as Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator, plus other media editing tools.
* Manage social media communication and relationship management; use social listening and public relations practices to understand audience conversations and respond appropriately.
* Monitor digital marketing performance using social media analytics, Google Analytics, web analytics, and marketing online analytics; share findings through clear reports and recommendations.
* Apply digital marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), keyword research, and Facebook Advertising knowledge; use Hootsuite or Buffer (application) to coordinate publishing and review marketing analytics and media performance analytics.

Your impact: By turning audience insights into relevant content and timely account decisions, you’ll help brands build stronger connections with their communities.

**Requirements**

* Experience or demonstrated ability in social media management, social media platforms, social media analytics, and digital marketing performance monitoring.
* Strong content writing, proofreading, and communication skills, with sound judgment when representing a brand online.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Creative Suite, and video or media editing tools.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics, Hootsuite, Buffer (application), SEO, keyword research, and Facebook Advertising; experience applying these tools is preferred.
* Organized, collaborative approach to managing account priorities, interpreting data, and presenting actionable recommendations.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Anaheim, CA 92805

jobs.title: Social Media Manager

Social Media Manager

* Whimsocal Studios | Full-Time, Hybrid
* Department: Marketing
* Reports To: Director of Marketing
* Brands: JuJuBe, Bella Tunno, Studio Oh!, Orange Circle Studio, and Saturday Sundae

The Social Media Manager will own the development, execution, and optimization of organic social media strategies across Whimsocal Studios' portfolio of brands. This is a hands-on role requiring both strategic thinking and creative execution. The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller, an experienced content creator, and a data-driven marketer who understands social trends, platform algorithms, audience behavior, and the importance of maintaining distinct brand identities. Working closely with the Director of Marketing, Product, Design, Ecommerce, and Sales, this individual will translate marketing priorities and product launches into compelling social content and measurable channel growth.

* Develop and execute organic social media strategies tailored to each brand's positioning, audience, and business objectives.

* Build platform-specific content strategies that support brand awareness, audience growth, engagement, website traffic, and product discovery.
* Identify emerging trends, cultural moments, and content opportunities relevant to each brand.
* Develop creative approaches to product launches, seasonal campaigns, brand storytelling, and evergreen content.
* Collaborate with the Director of Marketing to establish channel priorities, growth objectives, and performance benchmarks.

**Content Creation**

* Write compelling, brand-appropriate captions, hooks, and calls to action.
* Develop content briefs and shot lists for social media content needs, coordinating with Creative and Marketing on production.

* Maintain consistent visual storytelling and distinct brand voices across the portfolio.
* Identify opportunities to improve content quality, storytelling, and production efficiency.

* Coordinate with the Social Media Coordinator on publishing, scheduling, asset organization, and execution.
* Ensure social content follows internal review processes, brand guidelines, and applicable licensing approval requirements.

**Social Media Performance & Optimization**

* Own organic social media reporting, including reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, content performance, and referral traffic.
* Establish and maintain performance benchmarks to evaluate channel growth over time.
* Analyze content performance to identify what resonates with each brand's audience.
* Recommend content adjustments and testing opportunities based on performance insights.
* Provide monthly social media recaps highlighting key takeaways, opportunities, and actionable recommendations.
* Monitor platform changes and evolving best practices to continuously improve social performance.

**Social Execution & Channel Management**

* Oversee day-to-day social media execution and ensure content is published accurately and on schedule.
* Maintain visibility into publishing calendars, creative assets, campaign deadlines, and approval statuses.
* Guide the part-time Social Media Coordinator on approved content execution and publishing priorities.
* Ensure timely coordination of social assets, captions, links, and campaign materials.
* Partner with the Influencer & Community Coordinator to surface community feedback, emerging conversations, and content opportunities.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5+ years of professional experience in social media management, content creation, or digital marketing, preferably within consumer products, lifestyle, retail, or ecommerce.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing organic social strategies that drive measurable audience growth and engagement.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, and evolving social media trends.

* Experience working with licensed consumer products and approval processes is a plus.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Description:

**RxSight® is an ophthalmic medical technology corporation headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California that has commercialized the world’s first and only adjustable intraocular lens (IOL) that is customized after cataract surgery. The company’s mission is to revolutionize the premium cataract surgery experience by allowing surgeons to partner with their patients to achieve optimized results for every unique eye.**

**OVERVIEW:**

The Executive Assistant provides high-level administrative and operational support to the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) and other designated senior leadership positions. This highly visible role coordinates executive priorities, calendars, communications, meetings, travel, and confidential business matters, with particular emphasis on supporting the commercial organization. The successful candidate is proactive, resourceful, highly organized, and exercises exceptional judgment, professionalism, and discretion while managing competing priorities in a fast-paced public company environment.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Executive & Administrative Support**

* Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Chief Commercial Officer and other designated senior leaders, as needed.
* Manage complex executive calendars, prioritize competing requests, coordinate meetings, and anticipate scheduling conflicts to maximize executive effectiveness.
* Draft, edit, proofread, and prepare executive correspondence, reports, presentations, meeting materials, and other business documents with exceptional accuracy and professionalism.
* Manage incoming inquiries and communications, exercising sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism while ensuring timely follow-up.
* Anticipate the needs of the Chief Commercial Officer and supported senior leaders and proactively resolve administrative and logistical issues.
* Coordinate commercial leadership activities, including leadership meeting logistics, calendars, agendas, presentations, meeting notes, and follow-up on action items.
* Build strong relationships with executives, employees, customers, commercial partners, and external business contacts while serving as a trusted representative of the supported leaders.
* Support commercial strategic initiatives, cross-functional projects, and senior leadership priorities while maintaining the highest level of confidentiality.
* Organize office operations, procedures, and executive administrative activities to ensure efficient workflow.

**Meeting & Event Coordination**

* Plan, schedule, and coordinate executive and commercial leadership meetings and onsite or virtual events, ensuring meeting materials, technology, catering, logistics, and follow-up activities are completed seamlessly.
* Coordinate commercial leadership meetings, cross-functional meetings, company events, executive off-sites, and leadership retreats as requested.
* Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, supporting documentation, and action item summaries.
* Coordinate company-sponsored meals and hospitality arrangements as requested.

**Travel & Expense Management**

* Coordinate complex domestic and international travel arrangements for the Chief Commercial Officer and other designated senior leaders, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, visas, and detailed itineraries.
* Prepare, review, and reconcile travel and expense reports using Concur or equivalent expense management systems.
* Anticipate travel changes and resolve travel-related issues with minimal disruption.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Handle highly confidential business, personnel, commercial, and corporate information with the highest level of integrity, professionalism, and discretion.
* Represent the Chief Commercial Officer and other supported senior leaders professionally in all internal and external interactions.
* Maintain organized executive records, commercial leadership materials, meeting documentation, and action-item tracking in accordance with company policies and document retention requirements.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Requirements:

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Proficiency with video conferencing platforms (Microsoft Teams, Zoom).
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple assignments and consistently meet critical deadlines.
* Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to produce high-quality work with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain strict confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive business, employee, and commercial matters.
* Strong understanding of executive-level business operations and the coordination needs of a commercial leadership organization.
* Executive presence with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior leaders, employees, customers, and external business partners.
* Ability to work collaboratively across all levels of the organization in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* None

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, and TRAINING:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7–10 years of Executive Assistant experience supporting C-suite executives or other senior leaders, preferably including commercial leadership.
* Experience supporting multiple senior leaders and coordinating priorities across a complex organization; public company experience preferred.
* Experience supporting Commercial, Sales, Marketing, Business Development, or other cross-functional corporate organizations preferred.
* Demonstrated experience organizing executive and leadership meetings, preparing agendas and presentations, coordinating logistics, and tracking follow-up actions.
* Experience working in a public company environment and hand

jobs.description:
**EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT**  
**San Francisco Office**  
  
Debevoise & Plimpton LLP is a premier law firm with market-leading practices, a global perspective and strong New York roots. Our clients look to us to bring a distinctively high degree of quality, intensity and creativity to resolve legal challenges effectively and cost efficiently. We believe in hiring talented and dedicated individuals as members of our administrative community. We draw on the strength of our culture and structure to deliver the best of our firm to our lawyers and clients through true collaboration.  
  
The firm is seeking a full-time **Executive Assistant** who will provide senior-level support to two to four Partners and will be the point person for several other Lawyers (Counsels and Associates). The role is based in San Francisco, CA and will report to the Office Manager. The ideal candidate will be a motivated individual with a client service mindset who is eager to use business development and project management skills in a fast-paced, collaborative and team-oriented environment.  
  
This role is hybrid requiring in-office attendance four days per week, with one remote day per week.  
  
**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Proactively support Partners/Lawyers’ client, practice and business development activities and outreach.
* Provide administrative support to two to four Partners and several Lawyers (Counsels and Associates).
* Participate in fostering a culture that is team-oriented and committed to the highest levels of client service and professional excellence.

  
**Business Development/Client Impact:**

* Understand business development and client priorities of each supported Partner/Lawyer.
* Maintain and update current list of contacts and business activities in CRM/Interaction database.
* Keep track of clients and other contacts and proactively work with Partners/Lawyers to schedule calls and meetings with them.
* Build relationship with clients and client assistants.
* Execute requested follow up calls with clients.
* Schedule client entertainment and assist with local event management.
* Assist with preparing materials for use in meetings, pitches and proposals.
* Undertake research in support of Partners/Lawyers’ business development as directed.

  
**Administrative Support:**

* Manage complex calendars and coordinate scheduling across supported attorneys.
* Coordinate all travel arrangements including flights, hotels, ground transportation and itineraries.
* Process and submit expense reimbursements accurately and in a timely manner.
* Track and follow up on timesheet submissions for supported attorneys.
* Assist with preparation and organization of client files and matter materials.
* Handle incoming and outgoing communications, including calls, mail and courier coordination.
* Provide backup support to other Executive Assistants during high-volume periods. Draft, proofread and edit correspondence, memos and other documents.
* Coordinate with internal departments (Finance, IT, Facilities, Conflicts) to facilitate attorney needs.

**Requirements:**

* A minimum of three years of relevant experience as an executive-level assistant in a law firm, professional services firm or other corporate environment.
* A great sense of client service and comfortable working in a high pace environment.
* Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel and experience with CRM system.
* Excellent project management and analytical skills.
* Strong presentation and writing.
* Interpersonal skills and the ability to interact credibly, diplomatically and effectively with all levels within the firm and with clients.

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
* Law firm or corporate environment experience a plus.
* Excellent attendance, punctuality, and ability to work overtime.
* Ability to function under pressure.
* Knowledge of Interaction is a +.
* Detail oriented with strong day to day organizational skills.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, LPN
jobs.description:
The LPN Patient Program Coordinator is responsible for coordinating day-to-day program operations and overseeing patient flow to ensure an efficient, organized, and positive patient experience. This position serves as a key liaison between patients, physicians, clinical staff, and program management, facilitating communication and coordination throughout the patient care process.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily patient flow and coordinate the movement of patients through the program to support timely and efficient care.
* Serve as a primary liaison between patients, physicians, clinical staff, and the program manager.
* Facilitate communication regarding patient needs, appointments, scheduling, and program-related concerns.
* Support physicians and clinical staff with the coordination of daily program activities and patient needs.
* Assist the program manager with day-to-day operations, workflow, scheduling, and administrative functions.
* Monitor program activities and identify operational issues that may affect patient flow or the patient experience.
* Coordinate with internal departments and external providers as needed to ensure continuity and efficiency of services.
* Maintain accurate patient and program documentation in accordance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
* Provide patients and families with information regarding program services, processes, and resources.
* Assist with resolving patient concerns and escalate clinical or operational issues appropriately.
* Collaborate with the clinical team to ensure patient needs are communicated and addressed in a timely manner.
* Support the implementation of program policies, procedures, quality initiatives, and process improvements.
* Maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA, organizational policies, and applicable healthcare regulations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, nursing, public health, health sciences, or a related field preferred.
* Licensed Practical Nurse (Required)
* Maintains American Heart Association Basic Life Support
* Clinical knowledge and understanding of patient care processes required.
* Experience in a healthcare, clinical, or patient-facing environment required.
* Experience coordinating patient flow, clinical operations, or healthcare programs preferred.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with patients, physicians, and clinical staff.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency with electronic health records and Microsoft Office.
* Ability to maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and sound judgment when handling sensitive patient matters.

jobs.title: Independent Sales Representative – Audio Advertising & Creative Services
jobs.description:
Somewhere, a business owner is about to approve another ad nobody will remember. We’d like you to interrupt that meeting. Politely, preferably. Nugget Radio is looking for independent sales representatives who can spot an opportunity, start a genuine conversation and help a business find its voice. Sometimes that voice comes with a ridiculously catchy chorus. Great Music. Strange Company. Forever Free. That’s our station. Behind it is Rafa Brands LLC, and we’re building a creative-services business around original musical advertising, good ideas and people willing to do something a little different. WHAT YOU’LL BE SELLING We’re starting with custom jingles and musical advertisements, plus Nugget Radio placement opportunities under approved campaign terms. As our offerings develop, there will also be website, merchandise-store and social-content packages to discuss with the right clients. A neighborhood café. An artist. A pet business. A contractor with a great service and an advertisement that sounds like everyone else’s. There are plenty of conversations worth having. YOUR SIDE OF THE MICROPHONE Find businesses. Learn what they need. Show them relevant examples. Explain our approved offers. Follow up. Bring in paying clients with a clear brief so we can deliver what was promised. You can meet people locally, use your existing relationships, pick up the phone or prospect online. You don’t need to sit in our office. There isn’t an attendance prize. Keep your leads organized and your promises accurate. Final pricing, scope and unusual requests go through us. We won’t ask you to invent listener numbers, guarantee somebody’s sales or sell services we aren’t ready to deliver. YOU MIGHT FIT HERE IF… • You can talk with a business owner like a person, not a sales script wearing shoes. • You know how to listen, explain value and ask for the business. • You follow up without needing someone to chase you. • You’re comfortable with basic digital tools and keeping useful records. • You enjoy music, creative ideas and helping independent businesses get noticed. • You understand that building a client base takes actual work. Sales experience is useful. Existing business relationships are useful. A résumé containing the word “synergy” seventeen times is not required. LET’S TALK MONEY This is a commission-based contract opportunity, not a salaried position. Earnings depend on sales. We’re an early-stage business, so we’re not going to dress up a guess as a guaranteed annual income. You’ll receive written terms covering commission rates, eligible sales and payment timing before work begins. Customers pay the business directly; we handle billing and creative production. We’re also building in two things that matter: • Sales-training assistance funded from a portion of business sales, separate from your commission. • Referral rewards for introducing additional sales representatives to the team. The budgets, rewards and qualifying terms will be defined in writing. Flexible scheduling is part of the arrangement. WHERE YOU FIT Chicago is our initial recruiting focus, but we’re open to discussing other territories. Local visits, phone conversations and online outreach can all have a place here. INTERESTED? Tell us what you’ve sold, which kinds of businesses you understand and how you would start a conversation about an ad that’s actually a song. We’ll bring the music. Bring your curiosity, your follow-through and a little personality. Nugget Radio · Rafa Brands LLC

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program

Work Location: On the road
